entries.description_source_en: Wynaut can always be seen with a big, happy smile on its face. Look at its tail to determine if it is angry. When angered, this Pokémon will be slapping the ground with its tail.
entries.fact_source_en: WYNAUT can always be seen with a big, happy smile on its face. Look at its tail to determine if it is angry. When angered, this POKéMON will be slapping the ground with its tail.
entries.description_ru: Жизнерадостный покемон, почти всегда улыбающийся окружающим.
entries.fact_ru: Если Вайнот сердится, он начинает сердито хлопать хвостом по земле.

entries.description_source_en: Arrives alongside the first snow. It's thought that homes Snorunt visit will prosper for many generations. By tradition, one might offer a lump of ice made from pure water at one's front door.
entries.fact_source_en: SNORUNT live in regions with heavy snowfall. In seasons without snow, such as spring and summer, this POKéMON steals away to live quietly among stalactites and stalagmites deep in caverns.
entries.description_ru: Ледяной покемон, появляющийся вместе с первым снегом.
entries.fact_ru: Считается, что дом, который посетил Снорант, будет процветать многие поколения.

entries.description_source_en: It covers its body with an armor of ice harder than steel. Uses its breath to freeze prey, which it then devours as if they were frozen desserts.
entries.fact_source_en: Glalie has the ability to freely control ice. For example, it can instantly freeze its prey solid. After immobilizing its prey in ice, this Pokémon enjoys eating it in leisurely fashion.
entries.description_ru: Покемон, покрывающий себя ледяной бронёй прочнее стали.
entries.fact_ru: Глейли способен мгновенно замораживать добычу и неторопливо съедать её.

entries.description_source_en: During the season when drift ice approaches the shore, Spheal prefers living on the ice—where fewer predators lurk—rather than the land. Its fur retains heat superbly and resists harsh cold.
entries.fact_source_en: SPHEAL is much faster rolling than walking to get around. When groups of this POKéMON eat, they all clap at once to show their pleasure. Because of this, their mealtimes are noisy.
entries.description_ru: Милый морской покемон с густым тёплым мехом.
entries.fact_ru: Сфил быстрее перекатывается, чем ходит, а во время еды громко хлопает ластами.

entries.description_source_en: Its white whiskers are very sensitive. Sealeo will balance Spheal on the tip of its nose, checking its scent and its feel to be sure the Spheal is healthy.
entries.fact_source_en: SEALEO often balances and rolls things on the tip of its nose. While the POKéMON is rolling something, it checks the object’s aroma and texture to determine whether it likes the object or not.
entries.description_ru: Морской покемон с очень чувствительными белыми усами.
entries.fact_ru: Силео любит балансировать предметами на кончике носа, оценивая их запах и текстуру.

entries.description_source_en: Its thick tusks are strong enough to shatter drift ice. They have been known to break, but they will grow back by the next year. The Hisui region is well known for these broken tusks.
entries.fact_source_en: WALREIN’s two massively developed tusks can totally shatter blocks of ice weighing ten tons with one blow. This POKéMON’s thick coat of blubber insulates it from subzero temperatures.
entries.description_ru: Могучий морж-покемон с огромными клыками.
entries.fact_ru: Клыки Валрейна способны одним ударом расколоть многотонную льдину и ежегодно отрастают заново.

entries.description_source_en: Despite its appearance, it’s carnivorous. It clamps down on its prey with both sides of its shell and doesn’t let go until they stop moving.
entries.fact_source_en: CLAMPERL’s sturdy shell is not only good for protection - it is also used for clamping and catching prey. A fully grown CLAMPERL’s shell will be scored with nicks and scratches all over.
entries.description_ru: Хищный моллюск, крепко удерживающий добычу створками раковины.
entries.fact_ru: Панцирь Кламперла покрывается царапинами и отметинами по мере взросления.

entries.description_source_en: It’s not the strongest swimmer. It wags its tail to lure in its prey and then gulps them down as soon as they get close.
entries.fact_source_en: HUNTAIL’s tail is shaped like a fish. It uses the tail to attract prey, then swallows the prey whole with its large, gaping mouth. This POKéMON swims by wiggling its slender body like a snake.
entries.description_ru: Глубоководный хищник, заманивающий добычу необычным хвостом.
entries.fact_ru: Хантейл использует хвост, похожий на рыбу, как приманку.

entries.description_source_en: The color of its body changes with the water temperature. The coloration of Gorebyss in Alola is almost blindingly vivid.
entries.fact_source_en: Although GOREBYSS is the very picture of elegance and beauty while swimming, it is also cruel. When it spots prey, this POKéMON inserts its thin mouth into the prey’s body and drains the prey of its body fluids.
entries.description_ru: Изящный глубоководный покемон с изменчивой окраской тела.
entries.fact_ru: Несмотря на красоту, Горбисс высасывает жизненные соки своей добычи.

entries.description_source_en: Rock-hard scales and oil-filled swim bladders allow this Pokémon to survive the intense water pressure of the deep sea.
entries.fact_source_en: RELICANTH is a rare species that was discovered in deep-sea explorations. This POKéMON’s body withstands the enormous water pressure of the ocean depths. Its body is covered in tough scales that are like craggy rocks.
entries.description_ru: Древний морской покемон, выдерживающий огромное давление глубин.
entries.fact_ru: Каменные чешуйки и наполненный маслом плавательный пузырь помогают Реликанту жить на большой глубине.

entries.description_source_en: There was an era when it was overfished due to the rumor that having one of its heart-shaped scales would enable you to find a sweetheart.
entries.fact_source_en: LUVDISC’s heart-shaped body is a symbol of love and romance. It is said that any couple meeting this POKéMON is promised a loving relationship that never ends.
entries.description_ru: Покемон в форме сердца, ставший символом любви.
entries.fact_ru: По легендам, встреча с Лавдиском сулит влюблённым долгие счастливые отношения.

entries.description_source_en: Bagon jumps off cliffs every day, trying to grow stronger so that someday it will be able to fly.
entries.fact_source_en: BAGON harbors a never-ending dream of one day soaring high among the clouds. As if trying to dispel its frustration over its inability to fly, this POKéMON slams its hard head against huge rocks and shatters them into pebbles.
entries.description_ru: Молодой дракон, мечтающий однажды научиться летать.
entries.fact_ru: Бейгон ежедневно прыгает со скал, стремясь стать сильнее.

entries.description_source_en: This Pokémon has covered its body in a hard shell that has the same composition as bone. Shelgon stores energy for evolution.
entries.fact_source_en: Inside SHELGON’s armor-like shell, cells are in the midst of transformation to create an entirely new body. This POKéMON’s shell is extremely heavy, making its movements sluggish.
entries.description_ru: Покемон, скрытый в тяжёлом костяном панцире во время подготовки к эволюции.
entries.fact_ru: Внутри оболочки Шелгона полностью перестраивается новое тело.

entries.description_source_en: Salamence is an unusual Pokémon in that it was able to evolve a body with wings just by constantly wishing to be able to fly.
entries.fact_source_en: SALAMENCE came about as a result of a strong, long-held dream of growing wings. It is said that this powerful desire triggered a sudden mutation in this POKéMON’s cells, causing it to sprout its magnificent wings.
entries.description_ru: Могучий дракон, исполнивший свою давнюю мечту о полёте.
entries.fact_ru: Крылья Саламенса появились благодаря невероятно сильному желанию летать.

entries.description_source_en: From its rear, Beldum emits a magnetic force that rapidly pulls opponents in. They get skewered on Beldum’s sharp claws.
entries.fact_source_en: BELDUM keeps itself floating by generating a magnetic force that repels earth’s natural magnetism. When it sleeps, this POKéMON anchors itself to a cliff using the hooks on its rear.
entries.description_ru: Стальной покемон, использующий магнитную силу для полёта.
entries.fact_ru: Во сне Белдам цепляется задними когтями за отвесные скалы.

entries.description_source_en: Two Beldum have become stuck together via their own magnetic forces. With two brains, the resulting Metang has doubled psychic powers.
entries.fact_source_en: When two BELDUM fuse together, METANG is formed. The brains of the BELDUM are joined by a magnetic nervous system. By linking its brains magnetically, this POKéMON generates strong psychokinetic power.
entries.description_ru: Покемон, возникший после слияния двух Белдамов.
entries.fact_ru: Два объединённых мозга делают Метанга значительно сильнее психически.

entries.description_source_en: Because the magnetic powers of these Pokémon get stronger in freezing temperatures, Metagross living on snowy mountains are full of energy.
entries.fact_source_en: METAGROSS is the result of two METANG achieving fusion. When hunting, this POKéMON pins the prey to the ground under its massive body. It then eats the helpless victim using the large mouth on its stomach.
entries.description_ru: Сверхразумный покемон с невероятной магнитной силой.
entries.fact_ru: Метагросс прижимает добычу к земле тяжёлым телом и поедает её ртом на животе.

entries.description_source_en: Every bit of Regirock’s body is made of stone. As parts of its body erode, this Pokémon sticks rocks to itself to repair what’s been lost.
entries.fact_source_en: REGIROCK was sealed away by people long ago. If this POKéMON’s body is damaged in battle, it is said to seek out suitable rocks on its own to repair itself.
entries.description_ru: Легендарный каменный покемон, полностью состоящий из скал.
entries.fact_ru: Повреждённые части тела Реджирок восстанавливает, прикрепляя новые камни.

entries.description_source_en: With cold air that can reach temperatures as low as −328 degrees Fahrenheit, Regice instantly freezes any creature that approaches it.
entries.fact_source_en: Regice cloaks itself with frigid air of -328 degrees Fahrenheit. Things will freeze solid just by going near this Pokémon. Its icy body is so cold, it will not melt even if it is immersed in magma.
entries.description_ru: Легендарный ледяной покемон с экстремально низкой температурой тела.
entries.fact_ru: Тело Реджайса не тает даже при погружении в раскалённую магму.

entries.description_source_en: Registeel’s body is made of a strange material that is flexible enough to stretch and shrink but also more durable than any metal.
entries.fact_source_en: Its body is harder than any other kind of metal. The body metal is composed of a mysterious substance. Not only is it hard, it shrinks and stretches flexibly.
entries.description_ru: Легендарный стальной покемон из загадочного гибкого металла.
entries.fact_ru: Материал тела Реджистила одновременно невероятно прочен и способен растягиваться.

entries.description_source_en: Latias is highly sensitive to the emotions of people. If it senses any hostility, this Pokémon ruffles the feathers all over its body and cries shrilly to intimidate the foe.
entries.fact_source_en: LATIAS is highly intelligent and capable of understanding human speech. It is covered with a glass-like down. The POKéMON enfolds its body with its down and refracts light to alter its appearance.
entries.description_ru: Умный драконий покемон, чувствительный к человеческим эмоциям.
entries.fact_ru: Латиас умеет преломлять свет своими перьями, изменяя собственный облик.

entries.description_source_en: Latios has the ability to make others see an image of what it has seen or imagines in its head. This Pokémon is intelligent and understands human speech.
entries.fact_source_en: LATIOS will only open its heart to a TRAINER with a compassionate spirit. This POKéMON can fly faster than a jet plane by folding its forelegs to minimize air resistance.
entries.description_ru: Разумный дракон, понимающий человеческую речь.
entries.fact_ru: Латиос открывает сердце лишь добрым тренерам и летает быстрее реактивного самолёта.

entries.description_source_en: Through Primal Reversion and with nature’s full power, it will take back its true form. It can summon storms that cause the sea levels to rise.
entries.fact_source_en: KYOGRE is named in mythology as the POKéMON that expanded the sea by covering the land with torrential rains and towering tidal waves. It took to sleep after a cataclysmic battle with GROUDON.
entries.description_ru: Легендарный властелин морей, способный вызывать грандиозные штормы.
entries.fact_ru: После древней битвы с Граудоном Кайогр погрузился в долгий сон.

entries.description_source_en: Groudon is said to be the personification of the land itself. Legends tell of its many clashes against Kyogre, as each sought to gain the power of nature.
entries.fact_source_en: GROUDON has long been described in mythology as the POKéMON that raised lands and expanded continents. This POKéMON took to sleep after a cataclysmic battle with KYOGRE.
entries.description_ru: Легендарное воплощение суши и создатель континентов.
entries.fact_ru: Согласно легендам, Граудон неоднократно сражался с Кайогром за власть над природой.

entries.description_source_en: Rayquaza is said to have lived for hundreds of millions of years. Legends remain of how it put to rest the clash between Kyogre and Groudon.
entries.fact_source_en: RAYQUAZA is said to have lived for hundreds of millions of years in the earth’s ozone layer, above the clouds. Its existence had been completely unknown because it lived so high in the sky.
entries.description_ru: Небесный дракон, положивший конец противостоянию Кайогра и Граудона.
entries.fact_ru: Райкваза миллионы лет обитает высоко в озоновом слое, оставаясь незаметным для людей.
